       Members of the public are invited to participate. Under the Brown Act, the Committee is
       prohibited from acting on a matter brought to its attention during the General Public Comment
       period; however, issues raised by a member of the public may be added to the agenda for
       future meetings. Members of the public can also provide comments on an agenda item when
       it is being considered.

1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
      A. Call to Order - Chair Adele Slaughter (1 minute)
      B. Roll Call & Determination of quorum (9) - (Secretary Lynnette Kampe) (1 minute) In the event
      there is no quorum present, Motion items & discussions of motion items will be tabled until the
      next meeting.

2. ADMINISTRATIVE ANNOUNCEMENTS - We acknowledge the original stewards of what is now Los
Angeles County: the Kizh-Gabrieleño, Tongva, Chumash, Tataviam, Kitanemuk, Serrano, Luiseño and
Cahuilla people. We commit to uplifting the names of these lands and the community members from
more than 200 California First Nations who reside among us, and we honor their traditional ecological
knowledge. (1 minute)

3. WELCOME COMMENTS - Adele Slaughter, Chair (1 minute)
Report/Announcements - Adele Slaughter (10 minutes)
   A. Appoint an Ad Hoc committee to look into planting the empty tree wells in Los Angeles, reinstate Ad Hoc
      committee to review our bylaws
   B. Possible change of CFAC October meeting date from Oct. 1 to Oct.8th. Discussion and motion. Depending
      on when the UFMP comes out in September, we may need to call a Special Meeting due to the limited
      review period.
   C. The California Board of Forestry and Fire Protection voted unanimously to adopt the new "Zone Zero"
      defensible space regulations on August 19, 2026
   D. Status of the CFAC CIP final letter
   E. Reminder Letters to City Council and NCS on 5 Year watering uploaded in Letter Template Funding for
       Watering file on Google Drive. Please send a letter to your council member.
   F.​ Shade LA permitting reform letter status
   G.​ Possible Special Meeting in Sept. to review UFMP
   H.​ Other

minutes) Draft Minutes 08.06.2026
